title: 13 倒计时13
content_zh:
她总算明白为什么有的女生在路上偶尔心上人时会突然脸红心跳，话都不会说。
在他身边的椅子坐下后，又不知道说什么，满心盘算着爷爷今天又会给她多少钱。
“那你呢？”倪夏支着下巴，笑盈盈地靠近游决，“听说你还读了研，研究什么方向呀？”
不知道为什么，明明是普通的四个字，从游决嘴里说出来，像一阵凉凉的风刮过心口，听得倪夏后背凉凉的，不动声色地收回了靠近游决的肢体。
沉默中，倪夏忽然感觉到什么，回头一看，倪建国不知什么时候站在门口了。
倪建国年近八十的人了，不知是天生体质好，还是因为至今工作在一线，他看起来比同龄人至少年轻十岁。
可惜这圆形餐桌直径一米六，三个人分别落座，中间像隔了东非大裂谷。
“二来呢，你和夏夏是高中同学，我希望你们多联系，多互相帮助，这缘分不容易。”
他抿了口茶水，才又道：“夏夏她毕业两三年了，也没个正经工作，成天想着拍她那海产电影，折腾这么久，始终没有走上正途。”
“倪总，那不是海产，是发生在海底世界的奇幻故事。原著小说短小精悍，很有想象力，拍出来估计也会很受欢迎。”
眼看着倪建国眯起眼睛打量她，倪夏心头猛跳，立刻道：“是啊是啊，他可负责了，还来我家帮我整理资料呢。”
content_en:
She finally understood why some girls suddenly blushed and their hearts beat, and they couldn't say anything when they happened to have a crush on the street.
After sitting down on the chair next to him, she didn't know what to say and was thinking about how much money her grandfather would give her today.
"What about you?" Ni Xia held her chin up and approached You Jue with a smile. "I heard that you also went to graduate school. What direction are you studying?"
I don't know why, but these four words were obviously ordinary. When they came out of You Jue's mouth, they were like a cool wind blowing through his heart. Ni Xia felt a chill on her back and calmly retracted her limbs that were close to You Jue.
In the silence, Ni Xia suddenly felt something. Looking back, Ni Jianguo was standing at the door at some point.
Ni Jianguo is nearly 80 years old. Whether it is because he is born with good health or because he has been working on the front line, he looks at least ten years younger than his peers.
It's a pity that this round dining table is 1.6 meters in diameter. The three people were seated separately, and the middle seemed to be separated by the Great Rift Valley.
"Secondly, you and Xia Xia are high school classmates. I hope you can keep in touch more and help each other more. This fate is not easy."
He took a sip of tea and then continued: "Xia Xia has been graduating for two or three years, and she doesn't have a serious job. She thinks about making her seafood movie all day long. After struggling for so long, she has never taken the right path."
"Mr. Ni, that's not seafood, it's a fantasy story that takes place in the underwater world. The original novel is short, concise, and very imaginative. It will probably be very popular if it is filmed."
Seeing Ni Jianguo narrowing his eyes and looking at her, Ni Xia's heart skipped a beat and she immediately said: "Yes, yes, he is responsible, and he even came to my house to help me sort out the information."
